As a reaction, you can cause the rope to spring up and bind the creature, which must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be magically hoisted into the air, leaving it hanging upside down 3 feet above the ground. The creature is restrained there until the spell ends (up to 8 hours).
2014_spells.speak-with-animals.descripti: As an action, you cast this spell on yourself to gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for 10 minutes. While the knowledge and awareness of many beasts is limited by their intelligence, they can provide information at a minimum about nearby locations and monsters, including anything they have perceived within the past day. At the GM's discretion, you might be able to persuade a beast to perform a small favor for you.
2014_spells.speak-with-animals.effectSum: Gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts, allowing you to gather information about nearby locations and monsters.
2014_spells.speak-with-animals.fullDescr: As an action, you cast this spell on yourself to gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for 10 minutes. 2014_spells.tashas-caustic-brew.descript: A stream of acid emanates from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **2d4** acid damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. This effect lasts for a duration of concentration, up to 1 minute.
2014_spells.tashas-caustic-brew.effectSu: Emit a line of acid that deals damage to all creatures caught in its path, requiring a Dexterity saving throw for half damage.
2014_spells.tashas-caustic-brew.fullDesc: A stream of acid emanates from you in a line 30 feet long and 5 feet wide in a direction you choose. This effect lasts for a duration of concentration, up to 1 minute.
2014_spells.tasha-s-hideous-laughter.eff: Make a target incapacitated until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.tasha-s-hideous-laughter.ful: Using 1 action, at the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw; roll a d20, add the WIS modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration; The target has advantage on the saving throw if it's triggered by damage. At the end of each of its turns, and each time it takes damage, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
2014_spells.tensers-floating-disk.descri:
This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet. The disk remains for the duration of 1 hour and can hold up to 500 pounds. If more weight is placed on it, the spell ends, and everything on the disk falls to the ground.

- The disk stays still while you are within 20 feet of it.
- If you move more than 20 feet away, the disk follows you to remain within 20 feet.
- If you move more than 100 feet away, the spell ends.
- The disk can move across uneven terrain, stairs, and slopes, but it cannot cross an elevation change of 10 feet or more (e.g., it cannot cross or emerge from a pit deeper than 10 feet).
2014_spells.tensers-floating-disk.effect: Create a circular plane of force that floats 3 feet above the ground to carry up to 500 pounds of equipment or objects.

Additionally, if the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from you and knocked prone.
2014_spells.thunderous-smite.effectSumma: Empower your next melee weapon attack to deal extra thunder damage and potentially knock the target prone and push them away.
2014_spells.thunderous-smite.fullDescrip:

2014_spells.thunderwave.description:
As 1 action, a wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you. Each creature in a 15-foot cube originating from you must make a Constitution saving throw. 

- On a failed save, a creature takes **2d8** thunder damage and is pushed 10 feet away from you.
- On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed.

In addition, unsecured objects that are completely within the area of effect are automatically pushed 10 feet away from you, and the spell emits a thunderous boom audible out to 300 feet.
2014_spells.thunderwave.effectSummary: Release a wave of thunderous force in a 15-foot cube to damage creatures and push them and unsecured objects away from you.
2014_spells.thunderwave.fullDescription:

In addition, unsecured objects that are completely within the area of effect are automatically pushed 10 feet away from you, and the spell emits a thunderous boom audible out to 300 feet.
2014_spells.unseen-servant.description:
As an action, you create an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends. The servant springs into existence in an unoccupied space on the ground within 60 feet. It has AC 10, 1 hit point, and a Strength of 2, and it cannot attack. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends.

Once on each of your turns as a bonus action, you can mentally command the servant to move up to 15 feet and interact with an object. The servant can perform simple tasks that a human servant could do, such as:
- Fetching things
- Cleaning
- Mending
- Folding clothes
- Lighting fires
- Serving food
- Pouring wine

Once you give the command, the servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command. If you command the servant to perform a task that would move it more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.
2014_spells.unseen-servant.effectSummary: Create an invisible, mindless force within 60 feet that performs simple manual tasks under your mental command for up to one hour.

Once you give the command, the servant performs the task to the best of its ability until it completes the task, then waits for your next command. If you command the servant to perform a task that would move it more than 60 feet away from you, the spell ends.

Make a ranged spell attack against it. On a hit, the target takes **1d12** lightning damage. For the duration (Concentration, up to 1 minute), you can use your action on each of your turns to automatically deal **1d12** lightning damage to the target.
2014_spells.witch-bolt.effectSummary: Launch a beam of lightning at a target within 30 feet to deal immediate damage and sustain a damaging arc of energy.

2014_spells.alter-self.description:
As an action, you assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of up to 1 hour. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one:

- Aquatic Adaptation: You adapt your body to an aquatic environment, sprouting gills and growing webbing between your fingers. You can breathe underwater and gain a swimming speed equal to your walking speed.
- Change Appearance: You transform your appearance. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics, if any. You can make yourself appear as a member of another race, though none of your statistics change. You also can't appear as a creature of a different size than you, and your basic shape stays the same; if you're bipedal, you can't use this spell to become quadrupedal, for instance. At any time for the duration of the spell, you can use your action to change your appearance in this way again.
- Natural Weapons: You grow claws, fangs, spines, horns, or a different natural weapon of your choice. Your unarmed strikes deal **1d6** bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, as appropriate to the natural weapon you chose, and you are proficient with your unarmed strikes. Finally, the natural weapon is magic and you have a +1 bonus to the attack and damage rolls you make using it.
2014_spells.alter-self.effectSummary: A transformative spell allowing you to change your physical form for up to one hour, choosing between aquatic adaptation, appearance changes, or natural weapons.

2014_spells.animal-messenger.description:
As an action, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within 30 feet, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also speak a message of up to twenty-five words.

The target beast travels for the duration of 24 hours toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals.

When the messenger arrives, it delivers your message to the creature that you described, replicating the sound of your voice. The messenger speaks only to a creature matching the description you gave. If the messenger doesn't reach its destination before the spell ends, the message is lost, and the beast makes its way back to where you cast this spell.
2014_spells.animal-messenger.effectSumma: Use a Tiny beast within 30 feet to deliver a spoken message of up to twenty-five words to a specific recipient at a known location.

2014_spells.arcane-lock.description:
Using an action, you touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked until dispelled. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. Otherwise, it is impassable until it is broken or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Casting knock on the object suppresses arcane lock for 10 minutes.

While affected by this spell, the object is more difficult to break or force open; the DC to break it or pick any locks on it increases by 10.
2014_spells.arcane-lock.effectSummary: Magically lock an entryway or container, making it impassable and significantly harder to break or pick unless a password is used.

2014_spells.arcanists-magic-aura.descrip:
As an action, you place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object that isn't being carried or worn by another creature.

When you cast the spell, choose one or both of the following effects. The effect lasts for the duration of 24 hours. If you cast this spell on the same creature or object every day for 30 days, placing the same effect on it each time, the illusion lasts until it is dispelled.

- False Aura: You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects, such as detect magic, that detect magical auras. You can make a nonmagical object appear magical, a magical object appear nonmagical, or change the object's magical aura so that it appears to belong to a specific school of magic that you choose. When you use this effect on an object, you can make the false magic apparent to any creature that handles the item.
- Mask: You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects that detect creature types, such as a paladin's Divine Sense or the trigger of a symbol spell. You choose a creature type and other spells and magical effects treat the target as if it were a creature of that type or of that alignment.
2014_spells.arcanists-magic-aura.effectS: Place an illusion on a touched creature or object to deceive divination spells regarding its magical aura or creature type.

2014_spells.augury.description:
By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you spend 1 minute to receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The spell has a range of self and an instantaneous duration. The GM chooses from the following possible omens:

- Weal, for good results
- Woe, for bad results
- Weal and woe, for both good and bad results
- Nothing, for results that aren't especially good or bad

The spell doesn't take into account any possible circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion.

If you cast the spell two or more times before completing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The GM makes this roll in secret.

2014_spells.blindness-deafness.descripti: As 1 action, you can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet to make a Constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration of 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a Constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.
2014_spells.blindness-deafness.effectSum: Target a creature within 30 feet to potentially blind or deafen them, requiring a Constitution saving throw to resist or end the effect.

2014_spells.blur.description: As an action, you cause your body to become blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration of up to 1 minute, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.
2014_spells.blur.effectSummary: You make your form waver and shift, causing all creatures that rely on sight to have disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

2014_spells.calm-emotions.description:
As an action, you attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within 60 feet must make a Charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects:

- You can suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this spell ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.
- You can make a target indifferent about creatures of your choice that it is hostile toward. This indifference ends if the target is attacked or harmed by a spell or if it witnesses any of its friends being harmed. When the spell ends, the creature becomes hostile again, unless the GM rules otherwise.

The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched. This effect lasts until dispelled.
2014_spells.continual-flame.effectSummar: Touch an object to create a permanent, heatless flame that provides light equivalent to a torch and cannot be smothered or quenched.

2014_spells.cordon-of-arrows.description:
You plant four pieces of nonmagical ammunition—arrows or crossbow bolts—in the ground within 5 feet and lay magic upon them to protect an area. Until the spell ends after 8 hours, whenever a creature other than you moves to a space within 30 feet of the ammunition for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there, one piece of ammunition flies up to 30 feet to hit it.

- The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **1d6** piercing damage.
- The piece of ammunition is then destroyed.
- The spell ends when no ammunition remains.
- When you cast this spell, you can designate any creatures you choose, and the spell ignores them.
2014_spells.cordon-of-arrows.effectSumma: Plant four pieces of ammunition to create a magical perimeter that automatically attacks intruders with piercing damage until all ammunition is spent.

2014_spells.crown-of-madness.description: You target one humanoid of your choice that you can see within 120 feet. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become charmed by you for the duration (Concentration, up to 1 minute). While the target is charmed in this way, a twisted crown of jagged iron appears on its head, and a madness glows in its eyes. The charmed target must use its action before moving on each of its turns to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose.
2014_spells.crown-of-madness.effectSumma: Force a humanoid within 120 feet to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed, compelling them to attack other creatures on your command.

2014_spells.darkness.description:
As 1 action, you cause magical darkness to spread from a point you choose within 60 feet to fill a 15-foot-radius sphere for a duration of up to 10 minutes. The darkness spreads around corners. A creature with darkvision can't see through this darkness, and nonmagical light can't illuminate it.

- If the point you choose is on an object you are holding or one that isn't being worn or carried, the darkness emanates from the object and moves with it.
- Completely covering the source of the darkness with an opaque object, such as a bowl or a helm, blocks the darkness.
- If any of this spell's area overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell that created the light is dispelled.

2014_spells.darkvision.description: Using 1 action, you touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For a duration of 8 hours, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.
2014_spells.darkvision.effectSummary: Touch a willing creature to grant them the ability to see in the dark up to 60 feet for a duration of 8 hours.

2014_spells.detect-thoughts.description:
As an action, you can cast this spell to read the thoughts of certain creatures for a duration of up to 1 minute. While the spell is active, you can use your action on each turn to focus your mind on any one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. Creatures with an Intelligence of 3 or lower or those that do not speak any language are unaffected.

Initially, you learn the surface thoughts of the creature. As an action, you can shift your attention to another creature or probe deeper into the current target's mind. If you probe deeper, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw:
- On a failure, you gain insight into its reasoning, emotional state, and a dominant thought (such as a worry, love, or hate).
- On a success, the spell ends.

Regardless of the result, the target knows you are probing its mind. Unless you shift your attention, the creature can use its action to make an Intelligence check contested by your Intelligence check to end the spell.

This spell is highly effective for interrogation, as verbal questions shape the target's thoughts. Additionally, you can use an action to search for thinking creatures within 30 feet, even those you cannot see. This detection penetrates barriers, though it is blocked by 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead. Once detected, you can read the creature's thoughts as described above, provided they remain within range.
2014_spells.detect-thoughts.effectSummar: A mental intrusion spell that allows you to read the surface thoughts of creatures within 30 feet and probe deeper into their minds for emotional and reasoning insights.

This detection penetrates barriers, though it is blocked by 2 feet of rock, 2 inches of any metal other than lead, or a thin sheet of lead. Once detected, you can read the creature's thoughts as described above, provided they remain within range.
2014_spells.draconic-fear.description: You project a fearsome draconic visage. Each creature within a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. A frightened creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
2014_spells.draconic-fear.effectSummary: A powerful draconic projection that forces creatures in a 30-foot cone to become frightened of you upon failing a Wisdom saving throw.
2014_spells.draconic-fear.fullDescriptio: You project a fearsome draconic visage. Each creature within a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become frightened of you for 1 minute. 2014_spells.draconic-senses.description:
You touch a willing creature to grant it draconic senses for a duration of up to 1 hour. Until the spell ends, the target gains the following benefits:
- Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.
- Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight or hearing.
2014_spells.draconic-senses.effectSummar: A buffing spell that grants a willing creature enhanced sensory capabilities, including blindsight and advantage on specific Perception checks.

2014_spells.dust-devil.description: You choose an unoccupied 5-foot cube of air that you can see within 60 feet. An elemental force of swirling wind appears in the cube and lasts for the duration of the spell (Concentration, up to 1 minute). Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the swirling wind must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes **1d8** bludgeoning damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the cube.
2014_spells.dust-devil.effectSummary: Summon a swirling vortex of wind in a 5-foot cube that damages and pushes away any nearby creatures that fail a Strength saving throw.

2014_spells.earthbind.description: You choose one creature you can see within 300 feet. Yellow strips of magical energy loop around the creature. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or its flying speed (if any) is reduced to 0 feet for the duration (Concentration, up to 1 minute). An airborne creature affected by this spell safely descends at 60 feet per round until it reaches the ground or the spell ends.
2014_spells.earthbind.effectSummary: Bind a flying creature with magical energy, forcing it to the ground by reducing its flying speed to 0 on a failed Strength save.

2014_spells.elemental-bane.description: You choose one creature you can see within 90 feet and select one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the spell for a duration of Concentration, up to 1 minute. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra **1d6** damage of that type.
2014_spells.elemental-bane.effectSummary: Target a creature within 90 feet to make them vulnerable to a specific elemental damage type, dealing extra damage once per turn.
2014_spells.elemental-bane.fullDescripti: You choose one creature you can see within 90 feet and select one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. 2014_spells.enhance-ability.description:
Using 1 action, you touch a creature and bestow upon it a magical enhancement for a duration of up to 1 hour. Choose one of the following effects:

- Bear's Endurance: The target has advantage on Constitution checks and gains **2d6** temporary hit points, which are lost when the spell ends.
- Bull's Strength: The target has advantage on Strength checks, and its carrying capacity doubles.
- Cat's Grace: The target has advantage on Dexterity checks and does not take damage from falling 20 feet or less if it isn't incapacitated.
- Eagle's Splendor: The target has advantage on Charisma checks.
- Fox's Cunning: The target has advantage on Intelligence checks.
- Owl's Wisdom: The target has advantage on Wisdom checks.
2014_spells.enhance-ability.effectSummar: Touch a creature to grant them a magical enhancement that provides advantage on specific ability checks and other unique benefits.
2014_spells.enhance-ability.fullDescript:

- Owl's Wisdom: The target has advantage on Wisdom checks.
2014_spells.enlarge-reduce.description:
Using 1 action, you cause a creature or an object you can see within 30 feet to grow larger or smaller for a duration of up to 1 minute. Choose either a creature or an object that is neither worn nor carried. If the target is unwilling, it can make a Constitution saving throw; on a success, the spell has no effect.

If the target is a creature, everything it is wearing and carrying changes size with it. Any item dropped by an affected creature returns to normal size at once.

- Enlarge: The target's size doubles in all dimensions, and its weight is multiplied by eight. This increases its size by one category (e.g., Medium to Large). If there is insufficient room, the target attains the maximum possible size in the available space. Until the spell ends, the target has advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Weapons grow to match, and attacks with them deal **1d4** extra damage.
- Reduce: The target's size is halved in all dimensions, and its weight is reduced to one-eighth of normal. This decreases its size by one category (e.g., Medium to Small). Until the spell ends, the target has disadvantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Weapons shrink to match, and attacks with them deal **1d4** less damage (this cannot reduce damage below 1).
2014_spells.enlarge-reduce.effectSummary: Change the size of a creature or object within 30 feet, granting either strength bonuses and extra damage or strength penalties and reduced damage.

2014_spells.enthrall.description:
As an action, you weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within 60 feet and that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature that can't be charmed succeeds on this saving throw automatically, and if you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has advantage on the save.

On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the spell ends or until the target can no longer hear you. The spell lasts for 1 minute, but ends if you are incapacitated or can no longer speak.
2014_spells.enthrall.effectSummary: A distracting weave of words that forces chosen creatures within range to make a saving throw or suffer disadvantage on Perception checks.
2014_spells.enthrall.fullDescription:
As an action, you weave a distracting string of words, causing creatures of your choice that you can see within 60 feet and that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw. Any creature that can't be charmed succeeds on this saving throw automatically, and if you or your companions are fighting a creature, it has advantage on the save.

On a failed save, the target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive any creature other than you until the spell ends or until the target can no longer hear you. The spell lasts for 1 minute, but ends if you are incapacitated or can no longer speak.
2014_spells.find-steed.description:
With a casting time of 10 minutes, you summon a spirit that assumes the form of an unusually intelligent, strong, and loyal steed, creating a long-lasting bond with it. Appearing in an unoccupied space within 30 feet, the steed takes on a form that you choose, such as a warhorse, a pony, a camel, an elk, or a mastiff. (Your GM might allow other animals to be summoned as steeds.)

The steed has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a celestial, fey, or fiend (your choice) instead of its normal type. Additionally, if your steed has an Intelligence of 5 or less, its Intelligence becomes 6, and it gains the ability to understand one language of your choice that you speak.

Your steed serves you as a mount, both in combat and out, and you have an instinctive bond with it that allows you to fight as a seamless unit. While mounted on your steed, you can make any spell you cast that targets only you also target your steed.

- When the steed drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form.
- You can dismiss your steed at any time as an action, causing it to disappear.
- Casting this spell again summons the same steed, restored to its hit point maximum.
- While your steed is within 1 mile of you, you can communicate with it telepathically.
- You can't have more than one steed bonded by this spell at a time.
- As an action, you can release the steed from its bond at any time, causing it to disappear.
2014_spells.find-steed.effectSummary: Summon a loyal, intelligent spirit in the form of a steed to create a permanent bond for combat and travel.

2014_spells.find-traps.description:
As an action, you sense the presence of any trap within 120 feet that is within line of sight. A trap, for the purpose of this spell, includes anything that would inflict a sudden or unexpected effect you consider harmful or undesirable, which was specifically intended as such by its creator.

- The spell would sense an area affected by the alarm spell, a glyph of warding, or a mechanical pit trap.
- It would not reveal a natural weakness in the floor, an unstable ceiling, or a hidden sinkhole.

This spell merely reveals that a trap is present. You don't learn the location of each trap, but you do learn the general nature of the danger posed by a trap you sense.
2014_spells.find-traps.effectSummary: Sense the presence and general nature of harmful traps within line of sight, though not their exact locations.
2014_spells.find-traps.fullDescription:

2014_spells.flame-blade.description:
As a bonus action, you evoke a fiery blade in your free hand. The blade is similar in size and shape to a scimitar and lasts for a duration of up to 10 minutes. If you let go of the blade, it disappears, though you can evoke it again as a bonus action.

You can use your action to make a melee spell attack with the fiery blade. On a hit, the target takes **3d6** fire damage.

The flaming blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
2014_spells.flame-blade.effectSummary: Evoke a fiery blade in your free hand to perform melee spell attacks that deal fire damage for up to 10 minutes.
2014_spells.flame-blade.fullDescription:

The flaming blade sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
2014_spells.flaming-sphere.description:
As an action, a 5-foot-diameter sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space of your choice within 60 feet and lasts for up to 1 minute. Any creature that ends its turn within 5 feet of the sphere must make a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes **2d6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature must make the Dexterity saving throw against the sphere's damage, and the sphere stops moving this turn.

When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 feet tall and jump it across pits up to 10 feet wide. The sphere ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
2014_spells.flaming-sphere.effectSummary: Create a mobile sphere of fire that damages nearby creatures and can be moved as a bonus action to ram enemies.
2014_spells.flaming-sphere.fullDescripti:

When you move the sphere, you can direct it over barriers up to 5 feet tall and jump it across pits up to 10 feet wide. The sphere ignites flammable objects not being worn or carried, and it sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.
2014_spells.gentle-repose.description:
As an action, you touch a corpse or other remains. For a duration of 10 days, the target is protected from decay and cannot become undead.

The spell also effectively extends the time limit on raising the target from the dead, since days spent under the influence of this spell do not count against the time limit of spells such as raise dead.
2014_spells.gentle-repose.effectSummary: Protect a corpse from decay and prevent it from becoming undead, effectively pausing the time limit for resurrection spells.
2014_spells.gentle-repose.fullDescriptio:

2014_spells.gust-of-wind.description:
As 1 action, you create a line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide that blasts from you in a direction you choose for a duration of up to 1 minute. 

- Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.
- Any creature in the line must spend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves when moving closer to you.
- The gust disperses gas or vapor, and it extinguishes candles, torches, and similar unprotected flames in the area.
- Protected flames, such as those of lanterns, dance wildly and have a 50 percent chance to be extinguished.
- As a bonus action on each of your turns before the spell ends, you can change the direction in which the line blasts from you.
2014_spells.gust-of-wind.effectSummary: Create a 60-foot line of powerful wind that pushes creatures away, slows their approach, and extinguishes unprotected flames for up to 1 minute.
2014_spells.gust-of-wind.fullDescription:

2014_spells.heat-metal.description:
As 1 action, you choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within 60 feet and cause it to glow red-hot. 

- Any creature in physical contact with the object takes **2d8** fire damage when you cast the spell. 
- Until the spell ends (up to 1 minute), you can use a bonus action on each of your subsequent turns to cause this damage again.
- If a creature is holding or wearing the object and takes the damage, it must succeed on a constitution saving throw or drop the object if it can.
- If the creature does not drop the object, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until the start of your next turn.
2014_spells.heat-metal.effectSummary: Cause a manufactured metal object within 60 feet to glow red-hot, dealing fire damage to anyone touching it and potentially forcing them to drop it.

2014_spells.hold-person.description: As 1 action, you choose a humanoid that you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration of up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another wisdom saving throw; on a success, the spell ends on the target.
2014_spells.hold-person.effectSummary: Target a single humanoid within 60 feet to potentially paralyze them for up to 1 minute, with the target attempting to break free each turn.
2014_spells.hold-person.fullDescription: As 1 action, you choose a humanoid that you can see within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration of up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another wisdom saving throw; on a success, the spell ends on the target.
2014_spells.immovable-object.description: By touching an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds, you cause it to become magically fixed in place for a duration of up to 1 minute (requiring concentration). While fixed, the object can hold up to 4,000 pounds of weight.
2014_spells.immovable-object.effectSumma: Touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less to fix it magically in place, allowing it to support up to 4,000 pounds of weight.
2014_spells.immovable-object.fullDescrip: By touching an object that weighs no more than 10 pounds, you cause it to become magically fixed in place for a duration of up to 1 minute (requiring concentration). While fixed, the object can hold up to 4,000 pounds of weight.
2014_spells.invisibility.description: As an action, you touch a creature to make them invisible until the spell ends, which can last up to 1 hour. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is also invisible as long as it remains on the target's person. The spell ends immediately if the target attacks or casts a spell.
2014_spells.invisibility.effectSummary: Render a touched creature and all their equipment invisible for up to one hour, provided they do not attack or cast a spell.
2014_spells.invisibility.fullDescription: As an action, you touch a creature to make them invisible until the spell ends, which can last up to 1 hour. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is also invisible as long as it remains on the target's person. The spell ends immediately if the target attacks or casts a spell.
2014_spells.kinetic-jaunt.description:
You magically empower your movement with dance-like steps and spinning leaps for a duration of up to 1 minute (requiring concentration). While this spell is active: 
- You do not provoke opportunity attacks.
- Each foot of movement you make while not incapacitated costs 1 extra foot of movement instead of 1 foot.
- If you make a melee attack against a creature and hit the target, you can double the damage of the attack.
2014_spells.kinetic-jaunt.effectSummary: Empower your movement to avoid opportunity attacks and potentially double the damage of a successful melee attack while moving.

2014_spells.knock.description:
As an action, you choose an object that you can see within 60 feet. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.

- A target held shut by a mundane lock, or that is stuck or barred, becomes unlocked, unstuck, or unbarred. If the object has multiple locks, only one is unlocked.
- If the target is held shut with arcane lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes, allowing the target to be opened and shut normally.

When you cast this spell using a verbal component, a loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target object.
2014_spells.knock.effectSummary: Force open a locked or barred object within 60 feet, though the process creates a loud noise audible up to 300 feet away.
2014_spells.knock.fullDescription:

- If the target is held shut with arcane lock, that spell is suppressed for 10 minutes, allowing the target to be opened and shut normally.

When you cast this spell using a verbal component, a loud knock, audible from as far away as 300 feet, emanates from the target object.
2014_spells.lesser-restoration.descripti: Using an action, you touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
2014_spells.lesser-restoration.effectSum: Touch a creature to instantly cure them of a single disease or one of several specific debilitating conditions.
2014_spells.lesser-restoration.fullDescr: Using an action, you touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.
2014_spells.levitate.description:
As an action, one creature or object of your choice that you can see within 60 feet rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration of up to 10 minutes. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution saving throw is unaffected.

- The target can move only by pushing or pulling against a fixed object or surface within reach (such as a wall or a ceiling), allowing it to move as if it were climbing.
- You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn.
- If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you must use your action to move the target, which must remain within 60 feet.

When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
2014_spells.levitate.effectSummary: Cause a creature or object weighing up to 500 pounds to rise vertically and remain suspended in the air for up to 10 minutes.
2014_spells.levitate.fullDescription:

The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a Constitution saving throw is unaffected.

- You can change the target's altitude by up to 20 feet in either direction on your turn.
- If you are the target, you can move up or down as part of your move. Otherwise, you must use your action to move the target, which must remain within 60 feet.

When the spell ends, the target floats gently to the ground if it is still aloft.
2014_spells.locate-animals-or-plants.des: As an action, you describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. By concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present. This spell has a range of self and a duration of instantaneous.
2014_spells.locate-animals-or-plants.eff: By concentrating on the voice of nature, you determine the direction and distance to the nearest beast or plant of a specific kind within 5 miles.
2014_spells.locate-animals-or-plants.ful: As an action, you describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. By concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present. This spell has a range of self and a duration of instantaneous.
2014_spells.locate-object.description:
As an action, you describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

The spell can locate a specific object known to you, as long as you have seen it up close—within 30 feet—at least once. Alternatively, the spell can locate the nearest object of a particular kind, such as a certain kind of apparel, jewelry, furniture, tool, or weapon.

This spell can't locate an object if any thickness of lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between you and the object. The spell has a range of self and lasts for up to 10 minutes.
2014_spells.locate-object.effectSummary: Sense the direction of a familiar object or a specific type of item within 1,000 feet, including its direction of movement if it is moving.
2014_spells.locate-object.fullDescriptio:
As an action, you describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

The spell can locate a specific object known to you, as long as you have seen it up close—within 30 feet—at least once. Alternatively, the spell can locate the nearest object of a particular kind, such as a certain kind of apparel, jewelry, furniture, tool, or weapon.

This spell can't locate an object if any thickness of lead, even a thin sheet, blocks a direct path between you and the object. The spell has a range of self and lasts for up to 10 minutes.
2014_spells.magic-mouth.description:
Over the course of 1 minute, you plant a message onto an object within 30 feet that you can see and that is not worn or carried by another creature. You say the message, which should not exceed 25 words (though listening can take up to 10 minutes), and establish the circumstances that trigger the spell to deliver the message.

When these conditions are satisfied, a magical mouth appears on the object and articulates the message imitating your voice and tone. If the object has a mouth or similar feature, such as a statue, the magic mouth creates the illusion that the words come from that mouth.

When casting this spell, you may decide that the spell ends when the message is delivered or that it persists and repeats the message whenever the circumstances occur. The triggering circumstance can be as general or detailed as you like, but it must be based on visual or audible conditions that occur within 30 feet of the object. For example, you could instruct the mouth to speak when any creature moves within 30 feet of the object or when a silver bell rings within 30 feet of it. The spell lasts until dispelled.
2014_spells.magic-mouth.effectSummary: Implant a verbal message of up to 25 words onto an object that triggers and speaks in your voice when specific visual or audible conditions are met.
2014_spells.magic-mouth.fullDescription:

2014_spells.magic-weapon.description: As a bonus action, you touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, which lasts for up to 1 hour, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
2014_spells.magic-weapon.effectSummary: Touch a nonmagical weapon to imbue it with magical properties, granting a +1 bonus to both attack and damage rolls for up to one hour.
2014_spells.magic-weapon.fullDescription: As a bonus action, you touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, which lasts for up to 1 hour, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.
2014_spells.maximilian-s-earthen-grasp.e: Deal 2d6 bludgeoning damage to a target within 30 ft
2014_spells.maximilian-s-earthen-grasp.f: Using 1 action, you choose a 5-foot-square unoccupied space on ground that you can see within range. On a failed save, the target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained for the duration; The target takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success, the target escapes and the spell ends; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
2014_spells.melfs-acid-arrow.description: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within 90 feet and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes **4d4** acid damage immediately and **2d4** acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn. The spell has an instantaneous duration.
2014_spells.melfs-acid-arrow.effectSumma: Launch a shimmering green arrow at a target to deal immediate acid damage and lingering acid damage on the following turn.
2014_spells.melfs-acid-arrow.fullDescrip: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within 90 feet and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn. The spell has an instantaneous duration.
2014_spells.mind-spike.description: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking **3d8** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you always know the target's location until the spell ends (Concentration, up to 1 hour), but only if the target is within 60 feet of you. This spell requires somatic components to cast.
2014_spells.mind-spike.effectSummary: A psychic assault that deals damage to a target and allows you to track their location for up to one hour.
2014_spells.mind-spike.fullDescription: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within 60 feet. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw, taking **3d8** psychic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, you always know the target's location until the spell ends (Concentration, up to 1 hour), but only if the target is within 60 feet of you. This spell requires somatic components to cast.
2014_spells.mirror-image.description:
Using 1 action, you create three illusory duplicates of yourself in your space. Until the spell ends (1 minute), the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.

Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the spell's duration, roll a d20 to determine whether the attack instead targets one of your duplicates:
- With three duplicates, you must roll a 6 or higher to change the attack's target.
- With two duplicates, you must roll an 8 or higher.
- With one duplicate, you must roll an 11 or higher.

A duplicate's AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier. If an attack hits a duplicate, the duplicate is destroyed. A duplicate can be destroyed only by an attack that hits it; it ignores all other damage and effects. The spell ends when all three duplicates are destroyed.

A creature is unaffected by this spell if it can't see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false, as with truesight.
2014_spells.mirror-image.effectSummary: Create three illusory duplicates of yourself to deceive attackers, making it difficult for enemies to land a hit on you.
2014_spells.mirror-image.fullDescription:

2014_spells.misty-step.description: As a 1 bonus action, you are briefly surrounded by silvery mist and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. This effect is instantaneous.
2014_spells.misty-step.effectSummary: A quick teleportation spell that allows you to move up to 30 feet to a visible unoccupied space.
2014_spells.misty-step.fullDescription: As a 1 bonus action, you are briefly surrounded by silvery mist and teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see. This effect is instantaneous.
2014_spells.moonbeam.description:
As an action, you call down a silvery beam of pale light in a 5-foot radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within 120 feet. Until the spell ends, dim light fills the cylinder.

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it is engulfed in ghostly flames and must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes **2d10** radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

A shapechanger makes its saving throw with disadvantage. If it fails, it also instantly reverts to its original form and cannot assume a different form until it leaves the spell's light.

On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use an action to move the beam 60 feet in any direction.
2014_spells.moonbeam.effectSummary: Call down a cylinder of pale light that deals radiant damage to creatures within its area and forces shapechangers to revert to their original forms.
2014_spells.moonbeam.fullDescription:

On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use an action to move the beam 60 feet in any direction.
2014_spells.nystuls-magic-aura.descripti:
You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object that isn't being carried or worn by another creature. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following two effects, which lasts for the duration of 24 hours. If you cast this spell on the same creature or object every day for 30 days, the illusion lasts until it is dispelled.

- False Aura: You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects, such as detect magic, that detect magical auras. You can make a nonmagical object appear magical, a magical object appear nonmagical, or change the object's magical aura so that it appears to belong to a specific school of magic of your choice. When you use this effect on an object, you can make the false magic apparent to any creature that handles the item.
- Mask: You change the way the target appears to spells and magical effects that detect creature types, such as a paladin's Divine Sense or the trigger of a symbol spell. You choose a creature type and other spells and magical effects treat the target as if it were a creature of that type or of that alignment.
2014_spells.nystuls-magic-aura.effectSum: Apply an illusion to a touched creature or object to deceive divination spells, altering its magical aura or perceived creature type.
2014_spells.nystuls-magic-aura.fullDescr:

2014_spells.pass-without-trace.descripti: As an action, a veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. For the duration of up to 1 hour, each creature you choose within 30 feet of you (including you) has a +10 bonus to Dexterity (Stealth) checks and cannot be tracked except by magical means. A creature that receives this bonus leaves behind no tracks or other traces of its passage.
2014_spells.pass-without-trace.effectSum: Create a veil of shadows and silence that grants a massive bonus to Stealth checks and prevents non-magical tracking for you and your allies.
2014_spells.pass-without-trace.fullDescr: As an action, a veil of shadows and silence radiates from you, masking you and your companions from detection. 2014_spells.phantasmal-force.description:
You craft an illusion that takes root in the mind of a creature that you can see within 60 feet. The target must make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, you create a phantasmal object, creature, or other visible phenomenon of your choice that is size 10-foot cube or smaller and that is perceivable only to the target for a duration of up to 1 minute. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

The phantasm includes sound, temperature, and other stimuli, also evident only to the creature. The target can use its action to examine the phantasm with an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If the check succeeds, the target realizes that the phantasm is an illusion, and the spell ends.

While a target is affected by the spell:
- The target treats the phantasm as if it were real and rationalizes any illogical outcomes from interacting with it. For example, a target that walks across a phantasmal bridge that spans a pit falls once it steps onto the bridge. If the target survives the fall, it believes that the bridge has collapsed and it has fallen until it reaches the ground.
- An affected target can automatically succeed on saving throws against the effects it creates.
- A creature subjected to this spell is incapacitated while it interacts with the phantasm and takes **1d6** psychic damage each time it interacts with the phantasm.
2014_spells.phantasmal-force.effectSumma: Create a sensory illusion within the mind of a target creature that they perceive as real, causing psychic damage and incapacitation during interaction.
2014_spells.phantasmal-force.fullDescrip:

2014_spells.prayer-of-healing.descriptio: Over a casting time of 10 minutes, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet each regain hit points equal to **2d8** + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. The spell's duration is instantaneous.
2014_spells.prayer-of-healing.effectSumm: A ritualistic healing spell that restores hit points to up to six chosen creatures within range, excluding undead and constructs.
2014_spells.prayer-of-healing.fullDescri: Over a casting time of 10 minutes, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet each regain hit points equal to **2d8** + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. The spell's duration is instantaneous.
2014_spells.protection-from-poison.descr:
Using 1 action, you touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.

For a duration of 1 hour, the target gains the following benefits:
- Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.
- Resistance to poison damage.
2014_spells.protection-from-poison.effec: Neutralize an existing poison in a touched creature and provide them with resistance to poison damage and advantage on related saves.
2014_spells.protection-from-poison.fullD:
Using 1 action, you touch a creature. If it is poisoned, you neutralize the poison. If more than one poison afflicts the target, you neutralize one poison that you know is present, or you neutralize one at random.

For a duration of 1 hour, the target gains the following benefits:
- Advantage on saving throws against being poisoned.
- Resistance to poison damage.
2014_spells.pyrotechnics.description:
You choose an area of nonmagical flame that you can see within 60 feet and that fits within a 5-foot cube. Using this flame, you can create one of the following effects:
- Smoke: The smoke heavily obscures an area of a 10-foot cube for 1 minute.
- Light: You create a burst of light that blinds creatures in a 10-foot cube for 1 round.
2014_spells.pyrotechnics.effectSummary: Transform a small area of nonmagical flame into either a cloud of heavy obscuring smoke or a burst of blinding light.
2014_spells.pyrotechnics.fullDescription:
You choose an area of nonmagical flame that you can see within 60 feet and that fits within a 5-foot cube. Using this flame, you can create one of the following effects:
- Smoke: The smoke heavily obscures an area of a 10-foot cube for 1 minute.
- Light: You create a burst of light that blinds creatures in a 10-foot cube for 1 round.
2014_spells.ray-of-enfeeblement.descript:
As an action, you fire a black beam of enervating energy from your finger toward a creature within 60 feet. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends, which can last up to 1 minute.

At the end of each of the target's turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the spell. On a success, the spell ends.
2014_spells.ray-of-enfeeblement.effectSu: Fire a beam of energy to weaken a creature, forcing them to deal half damage with Strength-based weapon attacks.
2014_spells.ray-of-enfeeblement.fullDesc:
As an action, you fire a black beam of enervating energy from your finger toward a creature within 60 feet. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target deals only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength until the spell ends, which can last up to 1 minute.

At the end of each of the target's turns, it can make a Constitution saving throw against the spell. On a success, the spell ends.
2014_spells.rope-trick.description:
As an action, you touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts for 1 hour.

- Access: The space is reached by climbing to the top of the rope and can hold up to eight Medium or smaller creatures.
- Concealment: The rope can be pulled into the space, making it disappear from view outside.
- Protection: Attacks and spells cannot cross through the entrance into or out of the space, though those inside can see out as if through a 3-foot-by-5-foot window centered on the rope.
- Ending: Anything inside the extradimensional space drops out when the spell ends.
2014_spells.rope-trick.effectSummary: Create an invisible entrance to an extradimensional space at the top of a rope to hide or protect a small group.
2014_spells.rope-trick.fullDescription:
As an action, you touch a length of rope that is up to 60 feet long. One end of the rope rises into the air until the whole rope hangs perpendicular to the ground. At the upper end, an invisible entrance opens to an extradimensional space that lasts for 1 hour.

- Ending: Anything inside the extradimensional space drops out when the spell ends.
2014_spells.scorching-ray.description:
As an action, you create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within 120 feet. You can hurl these rays at a single target or distribute them among several.

Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes **2d6** fire damage.
2014_spells.scorching-ray.effectSummary: Create three rays of fire to hurl at one or multiple targets within 120 feet, dealing fire damage on a successful hit.
2014_spells.scorching-ray.fullDescriptio:
As an action, you create three rays of fire and hurl them at targets within 120 feet. You can hurl these rays at a single target or distribute them among several.

Make a ranged spell attack for each ray. On a hit, the target takes **2d6** fire damage.
2014_spells.see-invisibility.description: Using an action, you gain the ability to see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible for a duration of 1 hour. Additionally, you can see through the Ethereal Plane, where objects and creatures appear ghostly translucent.
2014_spells.see-invisibility.effectSumma: Grant yourself the ability to see invisible creatures and objects, as well as entities on the Ethereal Plane, for one hour.
2014_spells.see-invisibility.fullDescrip: Using an action, you gain the ability to see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible for a duration of 1 hour. Additionally, you can see through the Ethereal Plane, where objects and creatures appear ghostly translucent.
2014_spells.shadow-blade.description:
You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. This magic sword lasts for a duration of concentration, up to 1 minute.

- It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient.
- It deals **2d8** psychic damage on a hit.
- It has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60).
2014_spells.shadow-blade.effectSummary: Manifest a sword of solidified gloom that deals psychic damage and possesses the finesse, light, and thrown properties.
2014_spells.shadow-blade.fullDescription:
You weave together threads of shadow to create a sword of solidified gloom in your hand. This magic sword lasts for a duration of concentration, up to 1 minute.

- It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient.
- It deals **2d8** psychic damage on a hit.
- It has the finesse, light, and thrown properties (range 20/60).
2014_spells.shatter.description:
As an action, you cause a sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, to erupt from a point of your choice within 60 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. 

- A creature takes **3d8** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
- A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw.
- A non-magical item that is not worn or carried also suffers damage if it is in the area of the spell.
2014_spells.shatter.effectSummary: Create a painfully intense ringing noise at a specific point to deal thunder damage to creatures and non-magical objects in the area.
2014_spells.shatter.fullDescription:
As an action, you cause a sudden loud ringing noise, painfully intense, to erupt from a point of your choice within 60 feet. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Constitution saving throw. 

- A creature takes **3d8** thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
- A creature made of inorganic material such as stone, crystal, or metal has disadvantage on this saving throw.
- A non-magical item that is not worn or carried also suffers damage if it is in the area of the spell.
2014_spells.silence.description:
As an action, you create a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within 120 feet. For the duration of up to 10 minutes, no sound can be created within or pass through the sphere.

- Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage.
- Creatures are deafened while entirely inside the sphere.
- Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.
2014_spells.silence.effectSummary: Create a zone of absolute silence that prevents sound, deafens creatures, and blocks the casting of spells with verbal components.
2014_spells.silence.fullDescription:
As an action, you create a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within 120 feet. For the duration of up to 10 minutes, no sound can be created within or pass through the sphere.

- Any creature or object entirely inside the sphere is immune to thunder damage.
- Creatures are deafened while entirely inside the sphere.
- Casting a spell that includes a verbal component is impossible there.
2014_spells.skywrite.description: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words look like clouds and remain in place for the duration of the spell, which requires concentration for up to 1 hour.
2014_spells.skywrite.effectSummary: Form up to ten cloud-like words in the sky to convey a message that remains visible for the duration of the spell.
2014_spells.skywrite.fullDescription: You cause up to ten words to form in a part of the sky you can see. The words look like clouds and remain in place for the duration of the spell, which requires concentration for up to 1 hour.
2014_spells.spider-climb.description: As an action, you touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends (up to 1 hour), that creature gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.
2014_spells.spider-climb.effectSummary: Grant a willing creature the ability to scale vertical surfaces and ceilings while keeping their hands free and maintaining their walking speed as a climbing speed.
2014_spells.spider-climb.fullDescription: As an action, you touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends (up to 1 hour), that creature gains the ability to move up, down, and across vertical surfaces and upside down along ceilings, while leaving its hands free. The target also gains a climbing speed equal to its walking speed.
2014_spells.spike-growth.description:
As an action, you cause the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within 150 feet to twist and sprout hard spikes and thorns. For the duration of up to 10 minutes, the area becomes difficult terrain. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes **2d4** piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that cannot see the area at the time the spell is cast can make a Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.
2014_spells.spike-growth.effectSummary: Transform a 20-foot radius of ground into hazardous difficult terrain that deals piercing damage to any creature moving through it.
2014_spells.spike-growth.fullDescription:
As an action, you cause the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within 150 feet to twist and sprout hard spikes and thorns. For the duration of up to 10 minutes, the area becomes difficult terrain. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes **2d4** piercing damage for every 5 feet it travels.

The transformation of the ground is camouflaged to look natural. Any creature that cannot see the area at the time the spell is cast can make a Wisdom (Perception) check against your spell save DC to recognize the terrain as hazardous before entering it.
2014_spells.spiritual-weapon.description:
As a bonus action, you create a floating, spectral weapon within 60 feet that lasts for 1 minute or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to **1d8** + your spellcasting ability modifier.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

The weapon can take whatever form you choose. Clerics of deities who are associated with a particular weapon make this spell's effect resemble that weapon.
2014_spells.spiritual-weapon.effectSumma: Summon a floating spectral weapon to attack enemies using your bonus action, dealing force damage based on your spellcasting ability modifier.
2014_spells.spiritual-weapon.fullDescrip:
As a bonus action, you create a floating, spectral weapon within 60 feet that lasts for 1 minute or until you cast this spell again. When you cast the spell, you can make a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 feet of the weapon. On a hit, the target takes force damage equal to **1d8** + your spellcasting ability modifier.

As a bonus action on your turn, you can move the weapon up to 20 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it.

The weapon can take whatever form you choose. Clerics of deities who are associated with a particular weapon make this spell's effect resemble that weapon.
2014_spells.suggestion.description:
As an action, you suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence a creature you can see within 30 feet that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act ends the spell.

The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it pursues the course of action you described to the best of its ability for the duration of up to 8 hours. If the suggested activity can be completed in a shorter time, the spell ends when the subject finishes what it was asked to do.

You can also specify conditions that will trigger a special activity during the duration. For example, you might suggest that a knight give her warhorse to the first beggar she meets. If the condition isn't met before the spell expires, the activity isn't performed.

If you or any of your companions damage the target, the spell ends.

2014_spells.summon-beast.description:
You call forth a beast spirit, which manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within 90 feet. This corporeal form uses the Beast Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose an air, land, or water spirit. The creature resembles a beast of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.

The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends after up to 1 hour. The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you issue none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.
2014_spells.summon-beast.effectSummary: Call forth an air, land, or water beast spirit in an unoccupied space within 90 feet to act as an ally for up to 1 hour.

2014_spells.vortex-warp.description: You magically twist the space around another creature you can see within 90 feet. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (the target can choose to fail) or the target is teleported instantaneously to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 90 feet. The space must be on the ground or on a floor.
2014_spells.vortex-warp.effectSummary: Force a creature within 90 feet to succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be teleported to another visible unoccupied space.
2014_spells.vortex-warp.fullDescription: You magically twist the space around another creature you can see within 90 feet. 2014_spells.warding-bond.description:
As an action, you touch a willing creature to create a mystic connection that lasts for 1 hour. While the target is within 60 feet of you, it gains a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws, and it has resistance to all damage. However, each time the target takes damage, you take the same amount of damage.

The spell ends if any of the following occur:
- You drop to 0 hit points.
- You and the target are separated by more than 60 feet.
- The spell is cast again on either connected creature.
- You dismiss the spell as an action.
2014_spells.warding-bond.effectSummary: Create a mystic connection with a willing creature to grant them defensive bonuses and damage resistance while you share the burden of their injuries.

2014_spells.warding-wind.description:
A strong wind blowing at 20 miles per hour surrounds you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you for the duration of up to 10 minutes (Concentration). The wind has the following effects:
- It deafens you and other creatures in its area.
- It extinguishes all unprotected flames in its area that are not larger than a bonfire.
- It is difficult terrain for creatures in its area.
2014_spells.warding-wind.effectSummary: Surround yourself with a 20-mile-per-hour wind that creates difficult terrain and deafens nearby creatures while extinguishing small flames.

2014_spells.web.description:
As an action, you conjure a mass of thick, sticky webbing at a point of your choice within 60 feet. The webs fill a 20-foot cube from that point for up to 1 hour. The webs are difficult terrain and lightly obscure their area.

If the webs aren't anchored between two solid masses (such as walls or trees) or layered across a floor, wall, or ceiling, the conjured web collapses on itself, and the spell ends at the start of your next turn. Webs layered over a flat surface have a depth of 5 feet.

Each creature that starts its turn in the webs or that enters them during its turn must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is restrained as long as it remains in the webs or until it breaks free.

A creature restrained by the webs can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to no longer be restrained.

The webs are flammable. Any 5-foot cube of webs exposed to fire burns away in 1 round, dealing **2d4** fire damage to any creature that starts its turn in the fire.

2014_spells.zone-of-truth.description:
As an action, you create a magical zone that guards against deception in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within 60 feet. Until the spell ends after 10 minutes, a creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a Charisma saving throw. 

- On a failed save, a creature can't speak a deliberate lie while in the radius.
- You know whether each creature succeeds or fails on its saving throw.

An affected creature is aware of the spell and can thus avoid answering questions to which it would normally respond with a lie. Such a creature can remain evasive in its answers as long as it remains within the boundaries of the truth.

2014_spells.animate-dead.description:
This spell takes 1 minute to cast and creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within 10 feet. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a skeleton if you chose bones or a zombie if you chose a corpse.

- On each of your turns, you can use a bonus action to mentally command any creature you made with this spell if the creature is within 60 feet of you. 
- If you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the same command to each one.
- You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a general command, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor.
- If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures.
- Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete.

The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying any command you've given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature again before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to four creatures you have animated with this spell, rather than animating a new one.

2014_spells.beacon-of-hope.description:
As an action, you bestow hope and vitality upon any number of creatures within 30 feet. For the duration of up to 1 minute, each target gains the following benefits:

- Advantage on Wisdom saving throws.
- Advantage on death saving throws.
- Regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.
2014_spells.beacon-of-hope.effectSummary: Empower multiple creatures to receive maximum healing and gain advantage on Wisdom and death saving throws for up to one minute.

2014_spells.bestow-curse.description:
As an action, you touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of up to 1 minute. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options:

- Choose one ability score. While cursed, the target has disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability score.

- While cursed, the target has disadvantage on attack rolls against you.

- While cursed, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns. If it fails, it wastes its action that turn doing nothing.

- While the target is cursed, your attacks and spells deal an extra **1d8** necrotic damage to the target.

A remove curse spell ends this effect. At the GM's option, you may choose an alternative curse effect, but it should be no more powerful than those described above. The GM has final say on such a curse's effect.
2014_spells.bestow-curse.effectSummary: Touch a creature to impose a debilitating curse that lasts up to 1 minute, forcing the target to succeed on a Wisdom saving throw to resist.

2014_spells.blink.description:
Using an action, you cast this spell on yourself. Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of 1 minute. On a roll of 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you were already on that plane). At the start of your next turn, and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane, you return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near). You can dismiss this spell as an action.

While on the Ethereal Plane, you can see and hear the plane you originated from, which is cast in shades of gray, and you can't see anything there more than 60 feet away. You can only affect and be affected by other creatures on the Ethereal Plane. Creatures that aren't there can't perceive you or interact with you, unless they have the ability to do so.
2014_spells.blink.effectSummary: Enter the Ethereal Plane at the end of your turns for 1 minute, allowing you to avoid interaction with creatures on the Material Plane.
