2014_spells.call-lightning.description:
As an action, you create a storm cloud in the shape of a cylinder 10 feet tall with a 60-foot radius, centered on a point you can see 100 feet directly above you. The spell fails if you can't see a point in the air where the storm cloud could appear.

When you cast the spell, choose a point you can see within 120 feet. A bolt of lightning flashes down from the cloud to that point. Each creature within 5 feet of that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **3d10** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On each of your turns until the spell ends (up to 10 minutes), you can use your action to call down lightning in this way again, targeting the same point or a different one.

If you are outdoors in stormy conditions when you cast this spell, the spell gives you control over the existing storm instead of creating a new one. Under such conditions, the spell's damage increases by **1d10**.

2014_spells.catnap.description: As part of this spell, you make a calming gesture, and up to three willing creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet fall unconscious for the duration of 10 minutes. The spell ends on a target early if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake.

2014_spells.clairvoyance.description:
With a casting time of 10 minutes, you create an invisible sensor within 1 mile in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The sensor remains in place for up to 10 minutes, and it can't be attacked or otherwise interacted with.

When you cast the spell, you choose seeing or hearing. You can use the chosen sense through the sensor as if you were in its space. As your action, you can switch between seeing and hearing.

A creature that can see the sensor (such as a creature benefiting from see invisibility or truesight) sees a luminous, intangible orb about the size of your fist.

2014_spells.conjure-animals.description:
Using 1 action, you summon fey spirits that take the form of beasts and appear in unoccupied spaces that you can see within 60 feet. Choose one of the following options for what appears:

- One beast of challenge rating 2 or lower
- Two beasts of challenge rating 1 or lower
- Four beasts of challenge rating 1/2 or lower
- Eight beasts of challenge rating 1/4 or lower

Each beast is also considered fey, and it disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends after up to 1 hour.

The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns. They obey any verbal commands that you issue to them (no action required by you). If you don't issue any commands to them, they defend themselves from hostile creatures, but otherwise take no actions.

The GM has the creatures' statistics.

2014_spells.counterspell.description:
As a reaction, you attempt to interrupt a creature within 60 feet in the process of casting a spell. The effect depends on the level of the spell being cast:

- If the creature is casting a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell fails and has no effect.
- If it is casting a spell of 4th level or higher, you must make an ability check using your spellcasting ability. The DC equals 10 + the spell's level. On a success, the creature's spell fails and has no effect.

This spell has a casting time of 1 reaction, a range of 60 feet, and an instantaneous duration, requiring only a somatic component.
2014_spells.counterspell.effectSummary: A reactive spell used to interrupt another creature's casting process, automatically canceling low-level spells or requiring an ability check for higher-level ones.

2014_spells.create-food-and-water.descri:
Using 1 action, you create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within 30 feet. This is enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours.

- The food is bland but nourishing and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours.
- The water is clean and does not go bad.

This spell has an instantaneous duration and requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.create-food-and-water.effect: A utility spell that instantaneously generates a large quantity of bland food and clean water to sustain a group of humanoids or steeds.

2014_spells.daylight.description:
As 1 action, you create a 60-foot-radius sphere of light spreading from a point you choose within 60 feet. The sphere provides bright light and sheds dim light for an additional 60 feet. This effect lasts for 1 hour.

- If you choose a point on an object you are holding, or one that isn't being worn or carried, the light shines from the object and moves with it. Covering the object with an opaque item, such as a bowl or helm, blocks the light.
- If any area of this spell overlaps with darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower, the spell that created the darkness is dispelled.

This spell requires verbal and somatic components.

2014_spells.dispel-magic.description: As 1 action, you choose one creature, object, or magical effect within 120 feet. Any spell of 3rd level or lower on the target ends instantly. 2014_spells.dispel-magic.effectSummary: Target a creature, object, or magical effect within 120 feet to instantly end spells of 3rd level or lower, or attempt to end higher-level spells via an ability check.

- The target has resistance to one of the following damage types of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison.

2014_spells.enemies-abound.effectSummary: Target a single creature within 120 feet to manipulate its mind, forcing it to attack its allies and stripping it of its reactions.
2014_spells.enemies-abound.fullDescripti: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see within 120 feet and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature automatically succeeds if it is immune to being charmed. On a failed save, the target cannot take reactions and must use its action each turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose. This effect lasts for a duration of concentration, up to 1 minute.
2014_spells.erupting-earth.effectSummary: Deal 3d12 bludgeoning damage to a target within 120 ft
2014_spells.erupting-earth.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, choose a point you can see on the ground within range. A creature takes 3d12 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one; Each creature in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw; roll a d20, add the DEX modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC. The ground in that area becomes difficult terrain until cleared.
2014_spells.fear.description:
As 1 action, you project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone originating from yourself must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for a duration of up to 1 minute.

While frightened by this spell, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.
2014_spells.fear.effectSummary: Project a terrifying image in a 30-foot cone to frighten enemies, forcing them to drop their items and flee from you.
2014_spells.fear.fullDescription:
As 1 action, you project a phantasmal image of a creature's worst fears. Each creature in a 30-foot cone originating from yourself must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for a duration of up to 1 minute.

While frightened by this spell, a creature must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns, unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesn't have line of sight to you, the creature can make a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save, the spell ends for that creature.
2014_spells.fireball.description:
As an action, you flash a bright streak from your pointing finger to a point you choose within 150 feet, where it blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A target takes **8d6** fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The fire spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. This spell has a duration of instantaneous and requires verbal, somatic, and material components.
2014_spells.fireball.effectSummary: Launch a streak of fire to a distant point that explodes in a massive sphere, dealing heavy fire damage to all nearby creatures.
2014_spells.fireball.fullDescription:

The fire spreads around corners and ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. This spell has a duration of instantaneous and requires verbal, somatic, and material components.
2014_spells.flame-arrows.description: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. For the duration of concentration, up to 1 hour, when a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using a piece of ammunition drawn from the quiver, the target takes an extra **1d6** fire damage. This spell requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.flame-arrows.effectSummary: Enchant a quiver of ammunition so that every successful hit deals additional fire damage to the target for a limited duration.
2014_spells.flame-arrows.fullDescription: You touch a quiver containing arrows or bolts. For the duration of concentration, up to 1 hour, when a target is hit by a ranged weapon attack using a piece of ammunition drawn from the quiver, the target takes an extra **1d6** fire damage. This spell requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.fly.description: Using an action, you touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration of up to 10 minutes. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall. This spell requires verbal, somatic, and material components.
2014_spells.fly.effectSummary: Grant a willing creature the ability to fly at high speeds for up to ten minutes, provided they can handle the descent.
2014_spells.fly.fullDescription: Using an action, you touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration of up to 10 minutes. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still aloft, unless it can stop the fall. This spell requires verbal, somatic, and material components.
2014_spells.gaseous-form.description:
As an action, you touch a willing creature and transform them, along with everything they are wearing and carrying, into a misty cloud for a duration of up to 1 hour. The spell ends immediately if the creature drops to 0 hit points. Incorporeal creatures are not affected by this spell.

While in this form:
- The target's only method of movement is a flying speed of 10 feet.
- The target can enter and occupy the space of another creature.
- The target has resistance to nonmagical damage.
- The target has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws.
- The target can pass through small holes, narrow openings, and mere cracks, though liquids are treated as solid surfaces.
- The target cannot fall and remains hovering even when stunned or incapacitated.
- The target cannot talk, manipulate objects, attack, or cast spells. Any objects carried cannot be dropped, used, or interacted with.
2014_spells.gaseous-form.effectSummary: Transform a willing creature you touch into a misty cloud, granting them flight, resistance to nonmagical damage, and the ability to pass through narrow openings.
2014_spells.gaseous-form.fullDescription:

2014_spells.glyph-of-warding.description:
Over the course of 1 hour, you touch a surface or an object to inscribe a nearly invisible glyph. If placed on a surface, it can cover an area up to 10 feet in diameter. If placed in an object, the spell ends if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where it was cast. Finding the glyph requires a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC.

You define the trigger when casting the spell. Common triggers include touching the glyph, opening an object, or approaching within a certain distance. You can further refine triggers based on physical characteristics, creature kind, alignment, or passwords. Once triggered, the spell ends.

Choose one of the following effects:
- Explosive Runes: The glyph erupts in a 20-foot-radius sphere that spreads around corners. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, a creature takes **5d8** acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage (your choice); on a success, they take half as much damage.
- Spell Glyph: You store a prepared spell of 3rd level or lower by casting it as part of the glyph's creation. The stored spell triggers when the glyph is activated, targeting the creature that triggered it or centering its area on that creature. If the spell requires concentration, it lasts for its full duration.
2014_spells.glyph-of-warding.effectSumma: Inscribe a magical glyph on a surface or within an object that triggers a burst of energy or a stored spell when specific conditions are met.
2014_spells.glyph-of-warding.fullDescrip:

2014_spells.haste.description:
As an action, you target a willing creature you can see within 30 feet. For a duration of up to 1 minute, the target gains the following benefits:
- Their speed is doubled.
- They gain a +2 bonus to AC.
- They have advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
- They gain an additional action on each of their turns. This action can only be used to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

When the spell ends, a wave of lethargy sweeps over the target, leaving them unable to move or take actions until after their next turn.
2014_spells.haste.effectSummary: Accelerate a willing creature within 30 feet to double their speed, increase their AC, and grant them an additional action each turn.

2014_spells.hypnotic-pattern.description:
As 1 action, you create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within 120 feet. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for a duration of up to 1 minute. While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

The spell ends for an affected creature if it takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its stupor.
2014_spells.hypnotic-pattern.effectSumma: Create a 30-foot cube of twisting colors that charms and incapacitates any creature that sees it and fails a Wisdom saving throw.

2014_spells.intellect-fortress.effectSum: Grant yourself or a willing creature within range resistance to psychic damage and advantage on mental saving throws for one hour.
2014_spells.intellect-fortress.fullDescr: For a duration of 1 hour, you or one willing creature you can see within 30 feet has resistance to psychic damage, and has advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
2014_spells.intellect-fortress-2.descrip: For the duration, you or one willing creature you can see within range has resistance to psychic damage, as well as advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

2014_spells.leomund-s-tiny-hut.effectSum: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.leomund-s-tiny-hut.fullDescr: Using 1 minute, the spell fails if a creature larger than the space inside the dome is in the area when you cast the spell. A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration; Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome. Until the spell ends, you can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark; you can cast it as a ritual.
2014_spells.life-transference.descriptio: You sacrifice your own vitality to heal another creature. Upon casting, you take **4d8** necrotic damage, and one creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet regains a number of hit points equal to twice the necrotic damage you take. This spell has an instantaneous duration and requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.life-transference.effectSumm: You sacrifice your own health to provide a powerful healing effect to a chosen ally within 30 feet of you.
2014_spells.life-transference.fullDescri: You sacrifice your own vitality to heal another creature. Upon casting, you take **4d8** necrotic damage, and one creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet regains a number of hit points equal to twice the necrotic damage you take. This spell has an instantaneous duration and requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.lightning-bolt.description:
As 1 action, a stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d6** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. This spell has a range of Self and an instantaneous duration.
2014_spells.lightning-bolt.effectSummary: You unleash a powerful line of lightning that deals significant damage to all creatures caught in its path.
2014_spells.lightning-bolt.fullDescripti:
As 1 action, a stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes **8d6** lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The lightning ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. This spell has a range of Self and an instantaneous duration.
2014_spells.magic-circle.description:
Using a casting time of 1 minute, you create a 10-foot radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within 10 feet. Glowing runes appear whenever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface.

Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. The circle affects a creature of the chosen type in the following ways:

- The creature can't willingly enter the cylinder by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to do so, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw.
- The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the cylinder.
- Targets within the cylinder can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed by the creature.

When you cast this spell, you can elect to cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing a creature of the specified type from leaving the cylinder and protecting targets outside it. The spell lasts for 1 hour.
2014_spells.magic-circle.effectSummary: You create a protective cylinder of energy that prevents specific types of supernatural creatures from entering or leaving.
2014_spells.magic-circle.fullDescription:

Choose one or more of the following types of creatures: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead. The circle affects a creature of the chosen type in the following ways:

- The creature can't willingly enter the cylinder by nonmagical means. If the creature tries to use teleportation or interplanar travel to do so, it must first succeed on a Charisma saving throw.
- The creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against targets within the cylinder.
- Targets within the cylinder can't be charmed, frightened, or possessed by the creature.

When you cast this spell, you can elect to cause its magic to operate in the reverse direction, preventing a creature of the specified type from leaving the cylinder and protecting targets outside it. The spell lasts for 1 hour.
2014_spells.major-image.description:
Using 1 action, you create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within 120 feet and lasts for a duration of up to 10 minutes. It seems completely real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. You cannot create sufficient heat or cold to cause damage, a sound loud enough to deal thunder damage or deafen a creature, or a smell that might sicken a creature.

As long as you are within 120 feet of the illusion, you can use your action to cause the image to move to any other spot within range. As the image changes location, you can alter its appearance so that its movements appear natural for the image. For example, if you create an image of a creature and move it, you can alter the image so that it appears to be walking. Similarly, you can cause the illusion to make different sounds at different times, even making it carry on a conversation.

Physical interaction with the image reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successful Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image, and its other sensory qualities become faint to the creature.
2014_spells.major-image.effectSummary: Create a realistic visual, auditory, olfactory, and thermal illusion of an object or creature up to a 20-foot cube that can be moved and altered.

2014_spells.mass-healing-word.descriptio: As a bonus action, you call out words of restoration. Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within 60 feet regain hit points equal to **1d4** + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs. The effect is instantaneous.
2014_spells.mass-healing-word.effectSumm: A quick restoration spell that allows up to six visible creatures within range to regain a small amount of hit points instantly.
2014_spells.mass-healing-word.fullDescri: As a bonus action, you call out words of restoration. 2014_spells.meld-into-stone.description:
Using 1 action, you step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for a duration of 8 hours. Using your movement, you step into the stone at a point you can touch. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by nonmagical senses.

While merged with the stone:
- You cannot see what occurs outside it.
- Any Wisdom (Perception) checks you make to hear sounds outside it are made with disadvantage.
- You remain aware of the passage of time and can cast spells on yourself.
- You can use your movement to leave the stone where you entered it, which ends the spell. Otherwise, you cannot move.

Minor physical damage to the stone does not harm you, but its partial destruction or a change in its shape (to the extent that you no longer fit within it) expels you and deals **6d6** bludgeoning damage to you. The stone's complete destruction (or transmutation into a different substance) expels you and deals **50** bludgeoning damage to you. If expelled, you fall prone in an unoccupied space closest to where you first entered.
2014_spells.meld-into-stone.effectSummar: Merge yourself and your equipment into a stone surface to become undetectable, though your senses are limited while inside.

When you cast the spell and as a bonus action on each of your turns thereafter, you can expend one or two of the meteors, sending them streaking toward a point or points you choose within 120 feet of you.
2014_spells.melfs-minute-meteors.effectS: Create six orbiting tiny meteors that can be launched as a bonus action to strike targets within 120 feet over the spell's duration.

2014_spells.nondetection.description: Using 1 action, you touch a target to hide it from divination magic for a duration of 8 hours. The target can be a willing creature, a place, or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. While under this effect, the target cannot be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
2014_spells.nondetection.effectSummary: Protect a touched creature, object, or location from being targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying for 8 hours.
2014_spells.nondetection.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you touch a target to hide it from divination magic for a duration of 8 hours. The target can be a willing creature, a place, or an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. While under this effect, the target cannot be targeted by any divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.
2014_spells.phantom-steed.description:
With a casting time of 1 minute, a Large quasi-real, horselike creature appears on the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice within 30 feet. You decide the creature's appearance, and it comes equipped with a saddle, bit, and bridle. Any equipment created by the spell vanishes in a puff of smoke if carried more than 10 feet away from the steed.

For the duration of 1 hour, you or a creature you choose can ride the steed. The creature uses the statistics for a riding horse, except it has a speed of 100 feet and can travel 10 miles in an hour, or 13 miles at a fast pace. The spell ends if you use an action to dismiss it or if the steed takes any damage. When the spell ends, the steed gradually fades, giving the rider 1 minute to dismount.
2014_spells.phantom-steed.effectSummary: Summon a Large, quasi-real horse with a 100-foot speed to serve as a mount for you or another creature for 1 hour.
2014_spells.phantom-steed.fullDescriptio:

2014_spells.plant-growth.description:
This spell channels vitality into plants within 150 feet. There are two possible uses for the spell, granting either immediate or long-term benefits:

- If you cast this spell using 1 action, choose a point within range. All normal plants in a 100-foot radius centered on that point become thick and overgrown. A creature moving through the area must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves. You can exclude one or more areas of any size within the spell's area from being affected.
- If you cast this spell over 8 hours, you enrich the land. All plants in a half-mile radius centered on a point within range become enriched for 1 year. The plants yield twice the normal amount of food when harvested.
2014_spells.plant-growth.effectSummary: A versatile nature spell that can either instantly create difficult terrain by overgrowing plants or enrich the land over several hours to double food yields.

2014_spells.protection-from-energy.descr: As an action, you touch a willing creature. For the duration of up to 1 hour, that creature has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.
2014_spells.protection-from-energy.effec: A protective enchantment that grants a touched creature resistance to a specific elemental damage type for up to one hour.
2014_spells.protection-from-energy.fullD: As an action, you touch a willing creature. For the duration of up to 1 hour, that creature has resistance to one damage type of your choice: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.
2014_spells.pulse-wave.description:
You release a wave of concussive energy in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in that area must make a Constitution saving throw. 

- On a failed save, a creature takes **6d6** force damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away from you, and is knocked prone.
- On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed or knocked prone.

Unsecured objects that are not worn or caught are pushed up to 15 feet away from you. The spell's area is not blocked by total cover, but it is blocked by total opaque cover.
2014_spells.pulse-wave.effectSummary: A concussive blast of energy emitted in a cone that deals force damage, knocks enemies prone, and pushes objects and creatures away.
2014_spells.pulse-wave.fullDescription:

- On a failed save, a creature takes **6d6** force damage, is pushed up to 15 feet away from you, and is knocked prone.

2014_spells.remove-curse.description: As an action, you touch a creature or object to end all curses affecting it. If the object is a cursed magic item, the curse itself remains, but the spell breaks the owner's attunement to the object so it can be removed or discarded. This spell has a range of touch and a duration of instantaneous.
2014_spells.remove-curse.effectSummary: A restorative spell that ends all curses affecting a single creature or object, or breaks the attunement to a cursed magic item.

2014_spells.revivify.description:
Using an action, you touch a creature that has died within the last minute to return it to life with 1 hit point. This spell has a range of touch and a duration of instantaneous. Note the following limitations:
- It cannot return to life a creature that has died of old age.
- It cannot restore any missing body parts.

2014_spells.sending.description:
As an action, you send a short message of twenty-five words or less to a creature with which you are familiar. The spell has an unlimited range and a duration of 1 round. The target hears the message in its mind, recognizes you as the sender if it knows you, and can answer in a like manner immediately. 

Additional details include:
- Creatures with Intelligence scores of at least 1 can understand the meaning of the message.
- The message can be sent across any distance and to other planes of existence.
- If the target is on a different plane than you, there is a 5 percent chance that the message does not arrive.

2014_spells.sleet-storm.description:
As an action, you create a 20-foot-tall cylinder with a 40-foot radius centered on a point you choose within 150 feet. For the duration of up to 1 minute, freezing rain and sleet fall in the area, which is heavily obscured and douses any exposed flames.

The ground in the area is covered with slick ice, making it difficult terrain. When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall prone.

If a creature is concentrating in the spell's area, the creature must make a successful Constitution saving throw against your spell save DC or lose concentration.

2014_spells.slow.description:
As an action, you alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within 120 feet. Each target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected by this spell for the duration of up to 1 minute.

An affected target suffers the following effects:
- Its speed is halved.
- It takes a -2 penalty to AC and Dexterity saving throws.
- It cannot use reactions.
- On its turn, it can use either an action or a bonus action, but not both.
- Regardless of abilities or magic items, it cannot make more than one melee or ranged attack during its turn.

If the creature attempts to cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action, roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the spell does not take effect until the creature's next turn, and the creature must use its action on that turn to complete the spell; otherwise, the spell is wasted.

A creature affected by this spell makes another Wisdom saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.
2014_spells.slow.effectSummary: Manipulate time to hinder up to six creatures, reducing their speed, AC, and action economy while restricting their ability to attack and cast spells.

2014_spells.speak-with-dead.description:
As an action, you grant the semblance of life and intelligence to a corpse of your choice within 10 feet, allowing it to answer the questions you pose. The corpse must still have a mouth and cannot be undead. The spell fails if the corpse was the target of this spell within the last 10 days.

Until the spell ends after 10 minutes, you can ask the corpse up to five questions. The corpse knows only what it knew in life, including the languages it knew. Answers are usually brief, cryptic, or repetitive, and the corpse is under no compulsion to offer a truthful answer if you are hostile to it or it recognizes you as an enemy.

This spell does not return the creature's soul to its body, only its animating spirit. Consequently, the corpse cannot learn new information, does not comprehend anything that has happened since it died, and cannot speculate about future events.

2014_spells.speak-with-plants.descriptio:
As an action, you imbue plants within 30 feet of you with limited sentience and animation, giving them the ability to communicate with you and follow your simple commands. You can question plants about events in the spell's area within the past day, gaining information about creatures that have passed, weather, and other circumstances.

Additionally, you can manipulate the environment for the 10 minute duration:
- Turn difficult terrain caused by plant growth (such as thickets and undergrowth) into ordinary terrain.
- Turn ordinary terrain where plants are present into difficult terrain, causing vines and branches to hinder pursuers.

Plants might be able to perform other tasks on your behalf, at the GM's discretion. The spell doesn't enable plants to uproot themselves and move about, but they can freely move branches, tendrils, and stalks.

If a plant creature is in the area, you can communicate with it as if you shared a common language, but you gain no magical ability to influence it. This spell can cause the plants created by the entangle spell to release a restrained creature.

2014_spells.spirit-guardians.description:

- On a failed save, the creature takes **3d8** radiant damage (if you are good or neutral) or **3d8** necrotic damage (if you are evil).

2014_spells.spirit-shroud-2.description:

2014_spells.stinking-cloud.description:
As an action, you create a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow, nauseating gas centered on a point within 90 feet. The cloud spreads around corners, its area is heavily obscured, and it lingers in the air for up to 1 minute.

Each creature that is completely within the cloud at the start of its turn must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature spends its action that turn retching and reeling. Creatures that don't need to breathe or are immune to poison automatically succeed on this saving throw.

Environmental factors can disperse the cloud:
- A moderate wind (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses the cloud after 4 rounds.
- A strong wind (at least 20 miles per hour) disperses it after 1 round.

2014_spells.summon-fey.description:

When you cast the spell, choose a brisk, gentle, or phantasmal spirit; the creature resembles a fey of that type, which determines certain traits in its stat block.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions and disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends after up to 1 hour. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count but takes its turn immediately after yours.

- The creature obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you).
- If no commands are issued, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.

2014_spells.tiny-hut.description:
As an action taking 1 minute, you create a 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force that springs into existence around and above you. The dome remains stationary for a duration of 8 hours, though the spell ends immediately if you leave its area.

- Capacity: Up to nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside the dome with you. The spell fails if its area includes a larger creature or more than nine creatures.
- Permeability: Creatures and objects within the dome when you cast this spell can move through it freely, while all other creatures and objects are barred from passing through it.
- Magical Barrier: Spells and other magical effects cannot extend through the dome or be cast through it.
- Environment: The atmosphere inside the space is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside.
- Visibility: You can command the interior to become dimly lit or dark. The dome is opaque from the outside in any color you choose, but remains transparent from the inside.

2014_spells.tiny-servant.description: By using a touch, you animate one Tiny object that isn't a weapon or worn or held. The object sprouts little arms and legs and becomes a Tiny servant for a duration of 8 hours. This spell requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.tiny-servant.effectSummary: Animate a small, non-weaponized object by touching it, granting it limbs and transforming it into a Tiny servant for a set duration.

2014_spells.tongues.description: As an action, you touch a creature to grant it the ability to understand any spoken language it hears for 1 hour. Moreover, when the target speaks, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the target understands what it says. This spell requires verbal and material components.
2014_spells.tongues.effectSummary: Grant a touched creature the ability to understand all spoken languages and ensure that others can understand the target's speech.
2014_spells.tongues.fullDescription: As an action, you touch a creature to grant it the ability to understand any spoken language it hears for 1 hour. 2014_spells.vampiric-touch.description: As an action, you use the touch of your shadow-wreathed hand to siphon life force from others to heal your wounds. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target takes **3d6** necrotic damage, and you regain hit points equal to half the amount of necrotic damage dealt. Until the spell ends (up to 1 minute), you can make the attack again on each of your turns as an action. This spell requires verbal and somatic components.
2014_spells.vampiric-touch.effectSummary: Siphon life force from a creature using a melee spell attack to deal necrotic damage and heal yourself for half the damage dealt.

2014_spells.wall-of-sand.description: You conjure up a wall of swirling sand on the ground at a point you can see within 90 feet. The wall is 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick. It blocks line of sight but not movement. This effect lasts for a duration of Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
2014_spells.wall-of-sand.effectSummary: Conjure a 30-foot long wall of swirling sand that obstructs the line of sight for creatures while still allowing them to move through it.

2014_spells.water-breathing.description: As 1 action, this spell gives a maximum of ten willing creatures within 30 feet and you can see, the ability to breathe underwater until the end of its term. Affected creatures also retain their normal breathing pattern. The spell lasts for 24 hours.
2014_spells.water-breathing.effectSummar: Grant up to ten willing creatures the ability to breathe underwater for 24 hours while maintaining their normal breathing patterns.

2014_spells.water-walk.description:
As an action, you can grant up to ten willing creatures you can see within 30 feet the ability to move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground for 1 hour. Note that creatures crossing molten lava can still take damage from the heat.

If you target a creature submerged in a liquid, the spell carries the target to the surface of the liquid at a rate of 60 feet per round.
2014_spells.water-walk.effectSummary: Grant up to ten willing creatures the ability to walk across liquid surfaces, including lava and acid, as if they were solid ground.
2014_spells.water-walk.fullDescription:

2014_spells.wind-wall.description:
As an action, you cause a wall of strong wind to rise from the ground at a point you choose within 120 feet. The wall can be up to 50 feet long, 15 feet high, and 1 foot thick, shaped in any continuous path along the ground, and lasts for up to 1 minute.

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Strength saving throw. A creature takes **3d8** bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

The wall provides the following effects:
- Strong wind keeps fog, smoke, and other gases at bay.
- Small or smaller flying creatures or objects cannot pass through the wall.
- Loose, lightweight materials brought into the wall fly upward.
- Arrows, bolts, and other ordinary projectiles launched at targets behind the wall are deflected upward and automatically miss, though boulders hurled by giants or siege engines are unaffected.
- Creatures in gaseous form cannot pass through it.
2014_spells.wind-wall.effectSummary: Create a massive wall of wind that deflects projectiles, blocks gaseous creatures, and deals bludgeoning damage to those caught in its path.

2014_spells.arcane-eye.description:
As an action, you create an invisible, magical eye within 30 feet that hovers in the air for up to 1 hour. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which possesses normal vision and darkvision out to 30 feet and can look in every direction.

As an action, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. While there is no limit to how far the eye can move away from you, it cannot enter another plane of existence. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, though it can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.
2014_spells.arcane-eye.effectSummary: Summon an invisible magical eye to scout remote areas, providing visual information and darkvision from a distance.
2014_spells.arcane-eye.fullDescription:

2014_spells.banishment.description:
As an action, you attempt to send one creature that you can see within 60 feet to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be banished.

- If the target is native to the plane of existence you're on, you banish the target to a harmless demiplane where it is incapacitated. The target remains there until the spell ends, at which point it reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space.
- If the target is native to a different plane of existence than the one you're on, the target is banished with a faint popping noise, returning to its home plane. If the spell ends before 1 minute has passed, the target reappears in the space it left or in the nearest unoccupied space. Otherwise, the target doesn't return.
2014_spells.banishment.effectSummary: Target a single creature within 60 feet to be sent to another plane of existence, potentially removing them from combat for up to 1 minute.
2014_spells.banishment.fullDescription:

2014_spells.black-tentacles.description:
As an action, squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within 90 feet. For the duration of up to 1 minute, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

- When a creature enters the affected area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take **3d6** bludgeoning damage and be restrained by the tentacles until the spell ends.
- A creature that starts its turn in the area and is already restrained by the tentacles takes **3d6** bludgeoning damage.
- A creature restrained by the tentacles can use its action to make a Strength or Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.
2014_spells.black-tentacles.effectSummar: Create a 20-foot square of difficult terrain that deals bludgeoning damage and restrains creatures that enter or start their turn there.

2014_spells.blight.description:
As an action, necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within 30 feet, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a Constitution saving throw.

- The target takes **8d8** necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs.
- If you target a plant creature or a magical plant, it makes the saving throw with disadvantage, and the spell deals maximum damage to it.
- If you target a nonmagical plant that isn't a creature, such as a tree or shrub, it doesn't make a saving throw; it simply withers and dies.
2014_spells.blight.effectSummary: Blast a creature within 30 feet with necromantic energy to deal heavy necrotic damage, with special effects against plants.

2014_spells.compulsion.description:
As an action, you target creatures of your choice that you can see within 30 feet and that can hear you. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw, automatically succeeding if it cannot be charmed. On a failed save, the target is affected for a duration of up to 1 minute.

Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to designate a horizontal direction. Each affected target must use as much of its movement as possible to move in that direction on its next turn, though it may take any action before moving. After moving, the target can make another Wisdom saving throw to end the effect.

- Targets are not compelled to move into obviously deadly hazards, such as fire or a pit.
- Targets will provoke opportunity attacks to move in the designated direction.
2014_spells.compulsion.effectSummary: Force chosen creatures within 30 feet to move in a direction you designate using a bonus action on your turns.

2014_spells.confusion.description:
As an action, you assault the minds of creatures within a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within 90 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be affected for a duration of up to 1 minute.

An affected target cannot take reactions and must roll a **1d10** at the start of each of its turns to determine its behavior:
- 1: The creature uses all its movement to move in a random direction (determined by a **1d8** roll) and takes no action.
- 2-6: The creature does not move or take actions.
- 7-8: The creature uses its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within reach. If no creature is within reach, it does nothing.
- 9-10: The creature acts and moves normally.

At the end of each of its turns, an affected target can make a Wisdom saving throw to end the effect.

2014_spells.conjure-minor-elementals.des:
With a casting time of 1 minute, you summon elementals into unoccupied spaces you can see within 90 feet. You choose one of the following options for the summons:
- One elemental of challenge rating 2 or lower
- Two elementals of challenge rating 1 or lower
- Four elementals of challenge rating 1/2 or lower
- Eight elementals of challenge rating 1/4 or lower

The summoned creatures are friendly to you and your companions and remain for a duration of up to 1 hour, disappearing if they drop to 0 hit points or when the spell ends.

- Roll initiative for the summoned creatures as a group, which has its own turns.
- They obey verbal commands issued by you (no action required).
- If no commands are issued, they defend themselves from hostile creatures but otherwise take no actions.
- The GM provides the creatures' statistics.

2014_spells.control-water.description:
As an action, you cast this spell to control any freestanding water inside a chosen area that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. This effect lasts for a duration of up to 10 minutes. You choose one of the following effects upon casting, and as an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one:

- Flood: You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If the area includes a shore, the water spills onto dry land. In a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels across the area. Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave's path are carried with it, and those struck have a 25 percent chance of capsizing. The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you change effects; waves repeat on the start of your next turn.
- Part Water: You create a trench across the spell's area, with separated water forming walls on either side. This remains until the spell ends or you change effects, at which point the water fills the trench over the next round.
- Redirect Flow: You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction of your choice, even over obstacles or up walls. Once the water leaves the spell's area, it resumes flow based on terrain. This lasts until the spell ends or you change effects.
- Whirlpool: Requiring a body of water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep, you create a vortex 5 feet wide at the base, 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Creatures or objects within 25 feet of the vortex are pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature can swim away by making a Strength (Athletics) check against your spell save DC.

When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it takes **2d8** bludgeoning damage and is caught in the vortex until the spell ends. On a success, it takes half damage and is not caught. Caught creatures have disadvantage on the Strength (Athletics) check to swim away. Objects entering the vortex take **2d8** bludgeoning damage the first time each turn and every round they remain.

2014_spells.death-ward.description:
Using an action, you touch a creature to grant it protection from death for a duration of 8 hours. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends.

If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.
2014_spells.death-ward.effectSummary: Touch a creature to protect them from death, preventing them from dropping to 0 hit points or being killed instantaneously.
2014_spells.death-ward.fullDescription:
Using an action, you touch a creature to grant it protection from death for a duration of 8 hours. The first time the target would drop to 0 hit points as a result of taking damage, the target instead drops to 1 hit point, and the spell ends.

If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantaneously without dealing damage, that effect is instead negated against the target, and the spell ends.
2014_spells.dimension-door.description:
As an action, you teleport yourself from your current location to any other spot within 500 feet. You arrive at exactly the spot desired, whether it is a place you can see, visualize, or describe by distance and direction. The teleportation is instantaneous.

You can bring along objects as long as their weight does not exceed your carrying capacity. You can also bring one willing creature of your size or smaller who is carrying gear up to its carrying capacity, provided they are within 5 feet of you when you cast the spell.

If you arrive in a place already occupied by an object or a creature, you and any creature traveling with you each take **4d6** force damage, and the spell fails to teleport you.
2014_spells.dimension-door.effectSummary: Instantly teleport yourself and one willing creature to a specific location within 500 feet, potentially taking damage if the destination is occupied.
2014_spells.dimension-door.fullDescripti:

2014_spells.divination.description:
As an action, you use your magic and an offering to put yourself in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The GM offers a truthful reply, which might be a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen.

- The spell does not take into account circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion.
- If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The GM makes this roll in secret.
2014_spells.divination.effectSummary: Use magic and an offering to contact a deity or their servants to receive a truthful, though potentially cryptic, answer to a single question about a future event.
2014_spells.divination.fullDescription:
As an action, you use your magic and an offering to put yourself in contact with a god or a god's servants. You ask a single question concerning a specific goal, event, or activity to occur within 7 days. The GM offers a truthful reply, which might be a short phrase, a cryptic rhyme, or an omen.

- The spell does not take into account circumstances that might change the outcome, such as the casting of additional spells or the loss or gain of a companion.
- If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get a random reading. The GM makes this roll in secret.
2014_spells.dominate-beast.description:
As an action, you attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within 60 feet. It must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for up to 1 minute. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, the target has advantage on the saving throw.

While the creature is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as the two of you are on the same plane of existence. You can use this link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability.

- You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose and does nothing you do not allow. During this time, you can cause the creature to use a reaction by using your own reaction.
- Each time the target takes damage, it makes a new Wisdom saving throw against the spell. If the saving throw succeeds, the spell ends.
2014_spells.dominate-beast.effectSummary: Beguile a creature to establish a telepathic link for issuing general commands or take total, precise control of its actions for a short duration.

2014_spells.draconic-domination.descript:
You attempt to assert your will over a creature within 60 feet. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for up to 1 minute. While charmed, the target is under your control and can take only the actions you command.

- You can use your action to command the target to move, take an action, or take a bonus action.
- The target can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
2014_spells.draconic-domination.effectSu: Assert your will over a creature to charm it, allowing you to dictate its movements and actions through direct commands.

2014_spells.elemental-bane-4.description: You choose one creature you can see within 90 feet and select one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the spell for its duration of Concentration, up to 1 minute. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra **1d6** damage of that type.
2014_spells.elemental-bane-4.effectSumma: Target a creature within 90 feet to make them vulnerable to a specific elemental damage type, dealing extra damage each turn.
2014_spells.elemental-bane-4.fullDescrip: You choose one creature you can see within 90 feet and select one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the spell for its duration of Concentration, up to 1 minute. The first time each turn the affected target takes damage of the chosen type, the target takes an extra **1d6** damage of that type.
2014_spells.fabricate.description:
Using a casting time of 10 minutes, you convert raw materials that you can see within 120 feet into products of the same material. For example, you can fabricate a wooden bridge from a clump of trees, a rope from a patch of hemp, and clothes from flax or wool. The effect is Instantaneous.

You can fabricate a Large or smaller object (contained within a 10-foot cube, or eight connected 5-foot cubes), given a sufficient quantity of raw material. If you are working with metal, stone, or another mineral substance, however, the fabricated object can be no larger than Medium (contained within a single 5-foot cube). The quality of objects made by the spell is commensurate with the quality of the raw materials.

- Creatures or magic items can't be created or transmuted by this spell.
- You cannot create items that ordinarily require a high degree of craftsmanship, such as jewelry, weapons, glass, or armor, unless you have proficiency with the type of artisan's tools used to craft such objects.

2014_spells.faithful-hound.description:
As 1 action, you conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet. The hound remains for a duration of 8 hours, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.

The hound is invisible to all creatures except you and can't be harmed. When a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of it without first speaking the password that you specify when you cast this spell, the hound starts barking loudly. The hound sees invisible creatures, can see into the Ethereal Plane, and ignores illusions.

At the start of each of your turns, the hound attempts to bite one creature within 5 feet of it that is hostile to you. The hound's attack bonus is equal to your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus. On a hit, it deals **4d8** piercing damage.
2014_spells.faithful-hound.effectSummary: Conjure an invisible phantom watchdog that alerts you to intruders and attacks hostile creatures within its vicinity.

2014_spells.find-greater-steed.descripti: You summon a spirit that assumes the form of a loyal, majestic mount. Appearing in an unoccupied space within 30 feet, the steed takes on a form that you choose: a griffon, a pegasus, a peryton, a dire wolf, a rhinoceros, or a saber-toothed tiger. This spell has a duration of Instantaneous and requires verbal and somatic components.

2014_spells.fire-shield.description:
Using 1 action, you surround your body with thin and vaporous flame for 10 minutes. The shield radiates bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can end the spell using an action to make it disappear.

The flames act as either a heat shield or a cold shield, your choice:
- A heat shield gives you cold damage resistance.
- A cold shield gives you fire damage resistance.

Additionally, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, flames spring from the shield, dealing **2d8** fire damage or cold damage to the attacker, depending on the chosen shield type.
2014_spells.fire-shield.effectSummary: Envelop yourself in a protective layer of flame or frost that provides damage resistance and punishes melee attackers with elemental damage.

2014_spells.freedom-of-movement.descript:
Using 1 action, you touch a willing creature. For 1 hour, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells and other magical effects can neither reduce the target's speed nor cause the target to be paralyzed or restrained.

Furthermore, the target gains the following benefits:
- The target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape from nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature that has it grappled.
- Being underwater imposes no penalties on the target's movement or attacks.
2014_spells.freedom-of-movement.effectSu: Grant a willing creature immunity to movement-reducing effects, difficult terrain, and nonmagical restraints for a limited duration.

2014_spells.gate-seal.description: You fortify the fabric of the planes within a 30-foot cube centered on a point within 60 feet. Within that area, portals close and can't be opened by any means for a duration of 24 hours.
2014_spells.gate-seal.effectSummary: Fortify the fabric of the planes to close all portals within a 30-foot cube, preventing them from being reopened by any means for 24 hours.
2014_spells.gate-seal.fullDescription: You fortify the fabric of the planes within a 30-foot cube centered on a point within 60 feet. Within that area, portals close and can't be opened by any means for a duration of 24 hours.
2014_spells.giant-insect.description:
Using 1 action, you transform up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within 30 feet into giant versions of their natural forms for a duration of up to 10 minutes. A centipede becomes a giant centipede, a spider becomes a giant spider, a wasp becomes a giant wasp, and a scorpion becomes a giant scorpion.

- Each creature obeys your verbal commands, and in combat, they act on your turn each round. The GM has the statistics for these creatures and resolves their actions and movement.
- A creature remains in its giant size for the duration, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you use an action to dismiss the effect on it.
- The GM might allow you to choose different targets. For example, if you transform a bee, its giant version might have the same statistics as a giant wasp.

2014_spells.greater-invisibility.descrip: As 1 action, you or a creature you touch become invisible for a duration of up to 1 minute. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.
2014_spells.greater-invisibility.effectS: Grant invisibility to yourself or a touched creature, including all worn or carried equipment, for a duration of up to 1 minute.
2014_spells.greater-invisibility.fullDes: As 1 action, you or a creature you touch become invisible for a duration of up to 1 minute. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.
2014_spells.guardian-of-faith.descriptio:
As an action, you summon a Large spectral guardian that appears and hovers for 8 hours in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 30 feet. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity.

Any creature hostile to you that moves to a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw. The creature takes **20** radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The guardian vanishes when it has dealt a total of 60 damage.
2014_spells.guardian-of-faith.effectSumm: Summon a spectral guardian that hovers in a chosen space and deals radiant damage to hostile creatures that approach it.

2014_spells.hallucinatory-terrain.descri:
Over the course of 10 minutes, you make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube within 300 feet look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain for 24 hours. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed in appearance.

The tactile characteristics of the terrain are unchanged, so creatures entering the area are likely to see through the illusion. If the difference isn't obvious by touch, a creature carefully examining the illusion can attempt an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to disbelieve it. A creature who discerns the illusion for what it is sees it as a vague image superimposed on the terrain.
2014_spells.hallucinatory-terrain.effect: Alter the visual, auditory, and olfactory appearance of a 150-foot cube of natural terrain to mimic other natural landscapes.

2014_spells.ice-storm.description:
As an action, you call down a hail of rock-hard ice that pounds the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within 300 feet. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw.

- A creature takes **2d8** bludgeoning damage and **4d6** cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
- Hailstones turn the storm's area of effect into difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

2014_spells.locate-creature.description:
Using an action, you describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

- The spell can locate a specific creature known to you, or the nearest creature of a specific kind (such as a human or a unicorn), so long as you have seen such a creature up close—within 30 feet—at least once.
- If the creature you described or named is in a different form, such as being under the effects of a polymorph spell, this spell doesn't locate the creature.
- This spell can't locate a creature if running water at least 10 feet wide blocks a direct path between you and the creature.

2014_spells.phantasmal-killer.descriptio:
Using 1 action, you tap into the nightmares of a creature you can see within 120 feet and create an illusory manifestation of its deepest fears, visible only to that creature. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes frightened for the duration of up to 1 minute.

At the start of each of the target's turns before the spell ends, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take **4d10** psychic damage. On a successful save, the spell ends.
2014_spells.phantasmal-killer.effectSumm: Create a terrifying illusory manifestation of a creature's deepest fears to frighten them and deal recurring psychic damage over time.

2014_spells.polymorph.description:
As 1 action, you transform a creature you can see within 60 feet into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect, though a shapechanger automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

The transformation lasts for the duration of up to 1 hour, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The new form can be any beast whose challenge rating is equal to or less than the target's (or the target's level, if it doesn't have a challenge rating). The target's game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the chosen beast, though it retains its alignment and personality.

- The target assumes the hit points of its new form. When it reverts to its normal form, the creature returns to the number of hit points it had before it transformed.
- If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious.
- The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.
- The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
2014_spells.polymorph.effectSummary: Transform a willing or unwilling creature into a beast of equal or lower power, replacing its statistics and physical form.

- If it reverts as a result of dropping to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, it isn't knocked unconscious.
- The creature is limited in the actions it can perform by the nature of its new form, and it can't speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech.
- The target's gear melds into the new form. The creature can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of its equipment.
2014_spells.private-sanctum.description:
Over the course of 10 minutes, you make an area within 120 feet magically secure. The area is a cube that can be as small as 5 feet to as large as 100 feet on each side. The spell lasts for the duration of 24 hours or until you use an action to dismiss it.

When you cast the spell, you decide what sort of security the spell provides, choosing any or all of the following properties:

- Sound can't pass through the barrier at the edge of the warded area.
- The barrier of the warded area appears dark and foggy, preventing vision (including darkvision) through it.
- Sensors created by divination spells can't appear inside the protected area or pass through the barrier at its perimeter.
- Creatures in the area can't be targeted by divination spells.
- Nothing can teleport into or out of the warded area.
- Planar travel is blocked within the warded area.

Casting this spell on the same spot every day for a year makes this effect permanent.

2014_spells.resilient-sphere.description:
As an action, you create a sphere of shimmering force that encloses a creature or object of Large size or smaller within 30 feet. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or be enclosed for the duration of up to 1 minute.

Nothing—including physical objects, energy, or other spell effects—can pass through the barrier in or out, though a creature inside the sphere can still breathe. The sphere is immune to all damage, and a creature or object inside cannot be damaged by attacks or effects originating from outside, nor can a creature inside damage anything outside it.

The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the target. An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the walls, rolling the sphere at up to half the creature's speed. Other creatures can also pick up and move the globe.

2014_spells.secret-chest.description:
Using an action, you touch a chest and a miniature replica to hide the chest and all its contents on the Ethereal Plane. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).

While the chest is on the Ethereal Plane, you can use an action and touch the replica to recall the chest, causing it to appear in an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you. You can send the chest back to the Ethereal Plane by using an action and touching both the chest and the replica.

The spell's effect ends if you cast this spell again, if the smaller replica chest is destroyed, or if you choose to end the spell as an action. After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5 percent chance per day that the effect ends. If the spell ends while the larger chest is on the Ethereal Plane, it is irretrievably lost.

2014_spells.summon-aberration.descriptio:
You call forth an aberration spirit, which manifests in an unoccupied space that you can see within 90 feet. This corporeal form uses the aberration Spirit stat block. When you cast the spell, choose a type of watcher, slicer, or slime; the creature resembles an aberration of that type, which determines certain traits in the creature's stat block.

The spell lasts for up to 1 hour, and the creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares your initiative count, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you issue none, it takes the Dodge action and uses its move to avoid danger.

2014_spells.wall-of-fire.description:
Using 1 action, you create a wall of fire on a solid surface within 120 feet. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is opaque and lasts for a duration of up to 1 minute.

When the wall appears, each creature within its area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes **5d8** fire damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals **5d8** fire damage to each creature that ends its turn within 10 feet of that side or inside the wall. A creature takes the same damage when it enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. The other side of the wall deals no damage.

If it moves over a pit, a cliff, or other drop-off, it safely descends until it is hovering 10 feet above the ground; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
2014_spells.animate-objects.description:
As an action, you can bring up to ten nonmagical objects within 120 feet to life, provided they are not being worn or carried. The number of objects you can animate depends on their size:
- Tiny and Small targets count as one object.
- Medium targets count as two objects.
- Large targets count as four objects.
- Huge targets count as eight objects.

You cannot animate any object larger than Huge. Each target becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or it is reduced to 0 hit points.

As a bonus action, you can mentally command any creature made with this spell if it is within 500 feet of you. You can command any or all of them simultaneously, deciding their actions and movement for their next turn or issuing general commands like guarding a corridor. If no commands are given, the creature only defends itself. Once ordered, the creature follows the task until complete.

Animated objects are constructs with a speed of 30 feet (or a flying speed of 30 feet with hover if they lack legs). If securely attached to a surface, their speed is 0. They have blindsight with a radius of 30 feet and are blind beyond that distance. Their Constitution is 10, Intelligence and Wisdom are 3, and Charisma is 1. When an object drops to 0 hit points, it reverts to its original form, and remaining damage carries over to the object.

If commanded to attack, an object makes a single melee slam attack against a creature within 5 feet. The attack bonus and bludgeoning damage are determined by size:
- Tiny: +8 to hit, **1d4 + 4** damage (AC 18, 20 HP)
- Small: +6 to hit, **1d8 + 2** damage (AC 16, 25 HP)
- Medium: +5 to hit, **2d6 + 1** damage (AC 13, 40 HP)
- Large: +6 to hit, **2d10 + 2** damage (AC 10, 50 HP)
- Huge: +8 to hit, **2d12 + 4** damage (AC 10, 80 HP)

The GM may rule that a specific object inflicts slashing or piercing damage based on its form.

As an action, you create a shimmering barrier that extends in a 10-foot radius from you and moves with you for a duration of up to 1 hour. This barrier hedges out creatures other than undead and constructs.

- The barrier prevents an affected creature from passing or reaching through.
- Affected creatures can still cast spells or make attacks with ranged or reach weapons through the barrier.
- If you move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier, the spell ends.

2014_spells.arcane-hand.description:
As an action, you create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space you can see within 120 feet. The hand lasts for up to 1 minute and mimics your movements. It is an object with AC 20 and hit points equal to your hit point maximum; the spell ends if it drops to 0 hit points. It has a Strength of 26 (+8) and a Dexterity of 10 (+0), and it does not fill its space.

Upon casting and as a bonus action on subsequent turns, you can move the hand up to 60 feet and use one of the following effects:

- Clenched Fist: The hand strikes one creature or object within 5 feet. Make a melee spell attack using your statistics. On a hit, the target takes **4d8** force damage.
- Forceful Hand: The hand attempts to push a creature within 5 feet. Make a check with the hand's Strength contested by the target's Strength (Athletics) check. You have advantage if the target is Medium or smaller. On a success, the target is pushed 5 feet plus 5 times your spellcasting ability modifier.
- Grasping Hand: The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet using the hand's Strength score. You have advantage if the target is Medium or smaller. While grappling, you can use a bonus action to crush the target for bludgeoning damage equal to **2d6** + your spellcasting ability modifier.
- Interposing Hand: The hand stays between you and a chosen creature, providing you with half cover. Targets with a Strength score less than or equal to the hand's Strength cannot move through its space. Targets with a higher Strength score can move through, but the space is difficult terrain.

2014_spells.awaken.description:
After spending 8 hours tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant that has no Intelligence score or an Intelligence of 3 or less. The target gains an Intelligence of 10 and the ability to speak one language you know.

- If the target is a plant, it gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, and creepers, and gains senses similar to a human's. The GM chooses appropriate statistics, such as those for an awakened shrub or tree.
- The awakened creature is charmed by you for 30 days or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it.
- When the charmed condition ends, the creature decides whether to remain friendly based on its treatment while charmed.

2014_spells.cloudkill.description:

When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw. The creature takes **5d8** poison damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Creatures are affected even if they hold their breath or don't need to breathe.

The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, rolling along the surface of the ground. The vapors, being heavier than air, sink to the lowest level of the land, even pouring down openings.

2014_spells.commune.description:
Using a casting time of 1 minute, you contact your deity or a divine proxy and ask up to three questions that can be answered with a yes or no. You must ask your questions before the spell ends after 1 minute. You receive a correct answer for each question.

Divine beings aren't necessarily omniscient, so you might receive "unclear" as an answer if a question pertains to information that lies beyond the deity's knowledge. In a case where a one-word answer could be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the GM might offer a short phrase as an answer instead.

If you cast the spell two or more times before finishing your next long rest, there is a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first that you get no answer. The GM makes this roll in secret.
